complexity.notes: Minor style points: the loop variable `i` holds an Interval, so a name like `meeting` would read better, and `key = lambda x: x.start` has unusual spacing. A same-complexity alternative that avoids the heap is ||sorting the start and end times into two separate arrays and sweeping them with two pointers, counting concurrent meetings||.
complexity.summary: Sorts intervals by start time, then scans them while maintaining a min-heap of the end times of currently active meetings, popping rooms whose meetings have already ended; the answer is the heap's maximum size.
